attrs.evidence: lowering.mjs 0.2.0 freezes INPUT_PORT_SPEC, INSTANTIATION_SPEC, INSTANTIATION_SEM_ID, inputsSemId, portSemId and INSTANTIATION_RECEIPT_FIELDS, with instantiate() throwing instantiate-not-implemented. LOWERING_SEM_ID MOVED as a consequence and that is the point: LOWERING_SPEC carries inputs_model, so deciding the model changes the lowering relation, and an id that survived the ruling unchanged would be claiming the decision was not part of the relation. lowering_check.mjs case 'out-of-fragment-refused' asserts decided true, implemented false, three DECLARED falsifiers, and INSTANTIATION_SEM_ID distinct from LOWERING_SEM_ID; 9/9 with the refinement witness unchanged and still FILM-EVIDENCED. THE THREE FALSIFIERS ARE DECLARED AND NONE IS WRITTEN -- I-4a allocation-invariance, I-4b source-name-sensitivity, I-4c binding-has-force -- so this law is PROPERTY-TESTED for the DECISION and its refusal surface, and carries NO claim about instantiation behaviour, which does not exist yet. B2 writes the three.
attrs.revision_note: SUPERSEDED at B1.1 and kept as history. Revision 1 shipped an OVERBOUND identity projection -- LOWERING_SEM_ID and INSTANTIATION_SEM_ID hashed lifecycle fields, so implementing a frozen relation would have re-identified it -- and an EXTRA-INPUT REFUSAL that contradicted the source evaluator, justified by a claim about functions that is false. Both were correct-looking and wrong; the architecture they sat on was right and is unchanged in @2.
attrs.statement: INSTANTIATION IS A SEPARATE RELATION FROM LOWERING AND CARRIES ITS OWN IDENTITY. A target template can be perfectly lowered while instantiation binds "x" to the port for "y". Merge the two relations and a target failure becomes ambiguous between A MISTRANSLATED PROGRAM and CORRECTLY TRANSLATED CODE WITH MISWIRED INPUTS, which is the class of ambiguity this record has spent twenty-seven rounds removing. So: program_sem_id -(lowering_sem_id)-> target_template_sem_id, reusable and independent of invocation data; then target_template_sem_id + inputs_sem_id -(instantiation_sem_id)-> target_term_sem_id, the closed executable term. The earlier framing, PARAMETERIZED versus INSTANTIATED, was a FALSE CHOICE: the template is parameterized AND the executed term is necessarily closed. instantiation_sem_id IDENTIFIES THE RELATION AND NOT THE INVOCATION -- it commits to the input-port namespace and version, the source-name-to-port rule, missing- and extra-input semantics, the canonical embedding of an input value, template substitution semantics, the refusal vocabulary and the conformance vectors, and it does NOT contain x=5, which is inputs_sem_id. THE PORT IS BOUND TO THE SOURCE NAME: port identity is H(namespace | canonicalBytes(source_input_name)), taken at the canonical target-AST layer as {op:"input-port", source_name:N} BEFORE any textual or ic32 variable allocation, so two implementations that internally allocate _impl17 and q93 reach the SAME target_template_sem_id. The quotient is exact and it is the INVERSE OF ROUND 16: internal target variable names are non-semantic and alpha-equivalent, source input keys are semantic. Round 16's bug was identity depending on a spelling that should not matter; the danger here is identity depending on an ALLOCATION that should not matter while losing the SOURCE NAME that must. SOURCE INPUT NAMES ARE NOT UNICODE-NORMALIZED: if the frozen core distinguishes two code-point sequences as different names, port identity preserves that exact distinction, because normalizing at the encoding layer is a language-semantic change made where the source cannot see it. INSTANTIATION GETS NO FILM -- it is a deterministic relation, not a transition system, so its instrument is independent RE-INSTANTIATION against an InstantiationReceipt {target_template_sem_id, instantiation_sem_id, inputs_sem_id, target_term_sem_id}, the same argument that gives lowering re-lowering. DECIDED, NOT BUILT, and the two states are distinguishable by name: `input` refuses as lower-input-not-implemented rather than lower-inputs-undecided, because a refusal that conflates 'we have not ruled' with 'we have ruled and not written it' is a stale instrument with a delay fuse.
